title: Make current coordination-schema work-count regressions reject missing instrumentation
outcome: The no-historical-build regression tests fail when canonical work was not observed, while continuing to assert zero historical builds and exact schema/data preservation.
acceptance: The current-reopen and per-worker parallel-reopen controls require positive or exact observed current canonical work and observed content validation in addition to zero historical builds.

A meaningful discriminator demonstrates that absent/renamed/unrecorded canonical observation cannot make these controls pass; all existing no-historical-work, query-only and preservation assertions remain, with no elapsed ceiling or timeout inflation.
